hooks.name: Installed Power Capability Index
hooks.description: Indexes the current installed-power registry and limits activation to the smallest task-relevant capability.

action.prompt: Current installed-power routing: oando-workflow for this repository's orientation, graph/fork/database workflow, and power routing; design-system-power-builder only for complete design-system scaffolding; nova-act only for exploratory human-like browser automation; kane-cli only for repeatable browser workflows, screenshots, deployment smoke checks, or test-case authoring; postman only for Postman collections/API resources; context7 only for current official library/framework documentation; exa only for broad live-web research; ltm-power only for local project memory and resume/recall; cubic-code-review only for code-review/security-review information; cloudinary only for image/video asset operations; supabase-hosted only for Supabase/Postgres/auth/storage/RLS work. Verify a power is present in the current registry before activation; never route to removed or unavailable powers. Prefer repo-map and scripts/graph-impact.mjs over external powers when the repository can answer. Activate only the smallest relevant power, or none when no capability matches. Tests and gates are user-invoked only: do not load verify-and-gate or run test-like commands automatically. The block-agent-tests PreToolUse hook is unconditional because its payload cannot safely represent a trusted user-invocation exception.
